test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which country has the longest written constitution in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **With 146,385 words **in its **English-language edition**, the **Indian Constitution **is the world's **longest written constitution**.
 
• The **Indian Constitution**, which has **448 articles divided **into **25 parts **and **12 schedules**, is the longest written constitution of any **sovereign state in the world**.
 
• With **only 3,814 words**, the Constitution of **Monaco is the smallest written constitution**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There were **395 articles **originally in the **Constitution of India**.
 
• **Presently 448 articles **are there **in Constitution.**
 
• The **Indian Constitution **was originally **written in English**.
 
• **Prem Behari Narain Raizada **wrote the **Indian constitution by hand**.
 
• **Dr. BR Ambedkar **is known as the **father of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• **Indian Constitution **was **adopted **by the **Constituent Assembly **of **India on 26 November 1949 **and **became effective on 26 January 1950**.
